A '''hepatizon pickaxe''' is a [[Tools#Pickaxe|pickaxe]] of the [[Hepatizon equipment|hepatizon]] tier, made by smithing a [[copper pickaxe]] with [[hepatizon alloy]]. At speed 20 it is the fastest pickaxe in the pack, faster even than [[Adamant Pickaxe|adamant]] (15).

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

The upgrade needs no template, and enchantments on the copper item carry over.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===
It breaks pickaxe blocks at speed 20 and has 1000 durability. Obsidian itself breaks at speed 3 and drops nothing, but crying obsidian and ender chests are harvested normally.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/hepatizon_pickaxe.json}}</ref> The 1.12.1-alpha notes say that with Efficiency V it breaks stone instantly without Haste.

The pack also makes glass, glass panes, glowstone, sea lanterns and mob heads pickaxe blocks.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/pickaxe.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Hp|4.5}} damage at an attack speed of 1.2. While held in the main hand it adds 0.0055 to movement speed, 5.5% of the player's base speed.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with {{MCW|Block of Copper|blocks of copper}}. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Trading ===
An apprentice [[weaponsmith]] buys it for one [[hepatizon alloy]], so the alloy can be reused.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/weaponsmith/2/hepatizon_pickaxe.json}}</ref>

{{Uses}}

== Notes ==
* Hepatizon tools reuse the stone tools' item IDs, so they cannot be melted down in a blast furnace.

{{History|

{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|Smithing no longer takes an ingot in the template slot, and the upgrade keeps the base item's enchantments. Added the "Repaired with" tooltip. Mining speed raised from about 13 to 20, to keep hepatizon worth using after adamant.}}
